proof: Initially every pair has two free cells. At every later Maker turn, any pair already touched by Maker has a Breaker endpoint. Thus the next fresh Maker claim cannot complete a pair, including on a final legal claim: a Maker-owned mate would imply the proposed cell is already Breaker-owned. If a newly touched pair still has a free mate, that mate supplies a legal Breaker response even near exhaustion. If the mate is already Breaker-owned or Maker played outside all pairs, any available fresh filler preserves the invariant. If no reply remains, Maker has still not completed a pair. Every initially live full Snaky contains a displayed pair; targets already hit by old Breaker stones remain blocked. Therefore Maker never wins in this exact L_row state.
response_rule: After each legal Maker claim, if its paired mate is free, Breaker claims the mate. Otherwise Breaker claims any remaining fresh cell, for example the lexicographically least. Every filler remains permanently Breaker-owned.
scope: Complete physical Breaker defense at exact Maker-to-move L_row35+35 only. This certificate directly covers all live targets at the earlier state. L_cap and other ancestors remain unresolved; no empty14 defense or board-size lower bound.
